description: Evidence of neurologic weakness is documented.
Evidence of sensory loss (numbness/tingling) in a dermatomal pattern is documented.
Evidence of an abnormal or asymmetric reflex finding is documented.
Evidence of bowel or bladder dysfunction (possible cauda equina concern) is documented.
Conservative medication treatment (e.g. NSAIDs, muscle relaxants) is documented.
Conservative treatment duration of at least 6 weeks is documented.
Symptom duration of at least 6 weeks is documented.
Prior imaging (e.g. X-ray) results are documented.
A red-flag symptom (e.g. trauma, unexplained weight loss, fever, history of cancer) is documented as present or explicitly ruled out.
